original_test_intent: Validate the deployed NVSM shorthand `show temps` path and use its complete sensor output to verify all temperature identities, values and health against the approved thermal manifest.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; verify `show temps` is supported and document its schema/scope versus `show temperatures`; preserve logs; load sensor map/units/ranges and ambient/load/cooling context; run exact shorthand read-only; compare every returned sensor and detect any coverage/schema difference without substituting the canonical command.
manual_activity: NVSM/thermal owner confirms shorthand support/equivalence and supplies the sensor/range manifest.
required_inputs: Approved NVSM package/version and command-help/capability evidence
safety_requirements: Do not silently replace unsupported shorthand
Never clear logs or alter thermal controls
Preserve command error and schema/coverage differences
agent_execution_scope: Validate exact command support and manifest
Compare sensor completeness/values/health and alias differences
engineer_actions: Approve alias semantics and range policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Assuming shorthand equivalence without checking the deployed NVSM is insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal `nvsm show temps` only after help/schema verification; preserve any difference from canonical output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The shorthand command itself and all-sensor temperature/health coverage are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare shorthand output to its documented schema and, separately, record field/sensor-set differences from canonical output.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes command availability part of the test rather than assuming a typo or alias.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Canonical command success does not prove this source command is supported.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Aliases may be removed or expose reduced fields in some NVSM versions.

project_override_considerations: NVSM owner decides whether shorthand must independently work or may be formally deprecated; no silent rewrite is allowed.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Item, Procedure and Criteria consistently target the shorthand temperature query; alias uncertainty is a versioned project/package input, not contradictory source text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Approved NVSM build can establish command support; unsupported behavior is reported without substituting another command.

review_improvement: Preserves exact shorthand coverage and distinguishes unsupported syntax from thermal sensor failure.
independent_technical_reasoning: Command aliases are interface contracts: they may exist, differ in fields, or be removed. Replacing `temps` with `temperatures` would test a different source instruction and hide compatibility regression, so capability and schema evidence are required first.
